title: Removing applet through context menu does not trigger remove animation
line: Removing a desktop widget from its right-click menu now shrinks it away, like the Remove button in edit mode, instead of making it vanish at once.
explanation: The shrink animation only existed in plasma-desktop's ConfigOverlay.qml: the edit-mode Remove button animates the widget's container to scale 0 and only then triggers the applet's "remove" action. The context menu triggers that action directly; libplasma marks the applet destroyed (its PlasmoidItem hides itself) and emits appletRemoved, on which AppletsLayout deleted the container right away. AppletsLayout now, when the applet was removed by the user and its container is still visible and unscaled, keeps the item shown and shrinks the container to 0 over Kirigami's longDuration with the same InOutQuad easing, then unparents the applet item and deletes the container; the edit-mode path (container already at scale 0) and other removals are unchanged.

commits.message:
containmentlayoutmanager: animate widgets removed from their context menu

A widget removed from its context menu vanished at once, because only
the edit mode Remove button shrank it first. Now the layout shrinks any
widget the user removes before deleting its container, the same way.

BUG: 351579

media.caption: Pure master, 30 fps frames around clicking 'Remove Analog Clock' in the context menu: the clock is whole in one frame and gone in the next
With the fix, same steps: the clock shrinks to nothing over ~5 frames
Pure master: context menu > Remove Analog Clock, the clock disappears instantly
With the fix: the clock shrinks away like with the edit-mode Remove button
